init.description: Choose what you want to configure.
init.title: Wallet Assistant options

logos.description:
Logos can always be a Logo.dev domain (cached locally) or a file in your www folder (/local/...). When you enable this option, a logo can also be the https:// address of an image on any website.

Risk: every time someone opens the dashboard, their browser downloads that image directly from the external website. That website can see their IP address, browser and when the dashboard is opened, and the image can change or disappear at any time. Any user who can add or edit a card can choose such an address. Only enable this if you accept this risk.
logos.title: Logos and images

price_watch_service.description: The URL template must include {query}, which is replaced with the dashboard filter text. Use a domain such as example.com for the optional Logo.dev slug.
price_watch_service.title: Price-watch site

price_watch_services.description: Choose a price-watch site to edit, or add a new one. Changes are saved when you submit the site.
price_watch_services.title: Price-watch sites

promotion_platform.description: Credentials are saved in the integration options and used by platform adapters that support authentication. ENGIE Benefits needs only its public benefits URL. Argenco credentials are optional and are used to request account-specific voucher data when available. For Argenco and Edenred, provide the base32 TOTP seed used by your authenticator app when two-factor authentication is enabled. CrelanCo Deals currently uses an interactive reCAPTCHA; paste its shop_sid cookie here to use an authenticated browser session.
promotion_platform.title: Promotion platform

promotion_platforms.description: Choose a supported promotion platform to configure. Promotion data is refreshed at most once every 7 days.
promotion_platforms.title: Promotion platforms
